String.string:
[EN] Building Fences
[ES] Construyendo cercas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Please gather up the useful timber. I can use them to build fences along the road.
[ES] Por favor, junta la madera útil. Puedo usarla para construir cercas a lo largo del camino.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We'll be safe once the fence is done.
[ES] Estaremos a salvo una vez que la cerca esté lista.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "It was no trouble."
[ES] "No fue ninguna molestia."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Collect useful timber from around the Thrallfield.
[ES] Recolecta madera útil de los alrededores de Thrallfield.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the useful timber to Cregan, just off the road.
[ES] Entrega la madera útil a Cregan, justo al lado del camino.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
